# Forestry England

> Forestry England provides comprehensive guides to visiting forests and woodlands across the UK, offering diverse outdoor activities from walking and cycling to adventure experiences like Go Ape and family attractions.

Forestry England manages and promotes access to forests and woodlands throughout England, featuring over 1,500 locations with activities for all ages and abilities. The site emphasizes outdoor recreation, wellbeing, and family-friendly experiences while promoting responsible forest etiquette and accessibility.

## Getting Started

- [Home](https://www.forestryengland.uk): Forestry England homepage featuring outdoor activities like Go Ape, Segway, and cycling.
- [Visit a forest or woodland](https://www.forestryengland.uk/visit): Find and visit forests or woodlands near you with activity options and visitor info.
- [Know before you go](https://www.forestryengland.uk/know-before-you-go): Essential pre-visit planning guide covering Forest Code, safety, and forest etiquette.

## Activities & Outdoor Recreation

- [Things to do](https://www.forestryengland.uk/things-to-do): Comprehensive activities guide including Room on the Broom, Go Ape, and family attractions.
- [Activities and wellbeing](https://www.forestryengland.uk/activities-and-wellbeing): Overview of forest activities and wellbeing benefits including Nordic Walking and Disc Golf.
- [Walking](https://www.forestryengland.uk/walking): Walking trails guide from riverside strolls to Nordic Walking at Fineshade Wood and Westonbirt.
- [Cycling & mountain biking](https://www.forestryengland.uk/cycling): Cycling and mountain biking trails guide for families and experienced riders at forest locations.
- [Running](https://www.forestryengland.uk/running): Way-marked running trails 1k-10k with Parkrun locations, supported by Sport England.
- [Horse riding](https://www.forestryengland.uk/activities/horse-riding): Horse riding guide for Forest of Dean, New Forest, Hodgemoor Woods, and Cannock Chase.

## Family & Adventure Activities

- [Family forest fun](https://www.forestryengland.uk/family-forest-fun): Family activities including Room on the Broom, Gruffalo trails, and Pedal and Play cycling.
- [Go Ape](https://www.forestryengland.uk/go-ape): Go Ape adventure activities including Treetop Challenge, zip-wire, and Forest Segway experiences.
- [Adventure activities](https://www.forestryengland.uk/adventure-activities): Adventure activities overview including Go Ape, disc golf, orienteering, and picnics.
- [Gruffalo](https://www.forestryengland.uk/gruffalo): Gruffalo sculptures and orienteering courses by Julia Donaldson at High Lodge and other forests.
- [Play areas in the forest](https://www.forestryengland.uk/activities/play): Inclusive play areas at Westonbirt, High Lodge, Rendlesham, and Sherwood Pines forests.

## Accessibility & Special Interests

- [Easy access trails](https://www.forestryengland.uk/activities/easy-access-trails): Wheelchair and mobility-friendly trails at Fineshade Wood, Sherwood Pines with no barriers.
- [Visit with your dog](https://www.forestryengland.uk/visit-with-your-dog): Dog-friendly forest visits guide with Forest Code, etiquette, and camping holiday options.
- [Segway](https://www.forestryengland.uk/activities/segway): Segway forest tours at Cannock Chase Forest and Sherwood Pines with booking information.

## Events & Facilities

- [Events, music and arts](https://www.forestryengland.uk/events-music-and-arts): Events guide featuring Forest Live concerts, Forestry England Arts, and Earth Photo exhibitions.
- [Picnics and barbecues](https://www.forestryengland.uk/activities/picnics-and-barbecues): Picnic and barbecue facilities guide with fire safety rules and hire options at forest locations.

## Optional Resources

- [Forest activity sheets](https://www.forestryengland.uk/article/forest-activity-sheets): Free downloadable activity sheets for families featuring Gruffalo and Room on the Broom.
